issue.title: agent: Aside's models.json still asks Gemini models on google-generative-ai, which fails if Aside passes its own fetch (sibling of 2f5a3f1c0)
issue.body:
2f5a3f1c0 (v0.1.2187) left this sibling unchanged and named it in its body; this issue tracks it.

**The rule:** pi-ai's Google adapter throws before it sends when a request carries its own `fetch`: "Custom fetch is not supported by the Google Generative AI adapter" (`api/google-generative-ai.js`, pi-ai 0.83.0 and 1.4.0). Raft runs Pi's SDK on Pi's folder and passes such a fetch, so since v0.1.2042 (#3282) every Gemini model failed there (yunfei9958 on X). 2f5a3f1c0 keeps Gemini models on Chat in Pi's `models.json` (`piAsked` in `internal/agent/agents.go`).

**Aside isn't covered.** Aside also runs Pi's SDK, on its own `~/.aside/u/<account>/models.json`. magpie writes its block with `magpieProviderJSONAt("pi", "aside", …)` (`internal/agent/aside_native.go`). `piAsked("aside", …)` doesn't drop the Gemini API, so a Gemini-capable model is still written as `api: "google-generative-ai"` at the gateway's `/v1beta`. `piOffered("aside", …)` hides the thinking levels to match. If Aside passes a fetch the way Raft does, every Gemini model fails in Aside with the same error.

**What was checked:**
- The `aside` CLI isn't installed on the dev machine, and there is no `~/.aside`.
- npm has no matching package: `aside` on npm is an unrelated 0.0.1 placeholder, and `aside-codemode` is an extension, not the app.
- No public source was found. So it is unknown whether Aside's model runtime passes `fetch` (or `streamSimple`/`stream` options with `fetch`) to pi-ai.

**What would settle it:**
1. With a real Aside, connect magpie in a sandbox HOME and pick a Gemini model (a Gemini custom provider, a Google or Antigravity sign-in, or a plugin model declaring `@ai-sdk/google`). Send one prompt (`aside repl` or the app). The error above means it is affected. A reply, with the gateway logging `/v1beta/models/…:streamGenerateContent`, means it is fine.
2. Or, from Aside's bundled JS, grep for `fetch:` passed into the model runtime's stream options (as `installProviderHttpClient` does in Raft's daemon), and for the pi-ai version it bundles.

If it is affected: add `"aside"` to `piAsked`. `TestPiFolderKeepsGeminiOnChatForRaft` shows the test shape. If it isn't: write that down in `piAsked`'s comment and close this issue.

comments.body:
A fix is on [the fork branch](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/4428-aside-gemini-keeps-chat), commit [c5601602b](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c5601602b584ff91ea8e0fa95b5e2fda80ae784d), based on ed0ab567.

Aside now follows the same Chat fallback as Raft/Pi: piAsked also strips the Gemini API when agentID is aside, so its models.json no longer selects google-generative-ai at /v1beta. OmO and Prime Agent retain the Gemini API. The source catalog and Chat thinking levels are preserved.

The new config regression fails on the base and passes with the change; related Pi/Raft/Google model tests pass under race, including an independent parent run. Agent vet and the offline nogui build pass. No real Aside installation or live Gemini request was exercised; this verifies the generated configuration, and the runtime custom-fetch failure follows the case described here. AI-assisted implementation and review.
